newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai auctions land of bankrupt firm for staff.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai auctions land of bankrupt firm for staff.

text.p: Shanghai will auction the land of a bankrupt state-owned firm and use the money to help settle the staff in new jobs, the Shanghai Securities newspaper said on Thursday.
It is the first time that the land of a bankrupt company has been sold off to help clear up its financial affairs, the newspaper said.
Most bankrupt state firms which are wound up are merged with other state enterprises, which take over all their debts and assets.
The Shanghai No. 4 Plastic Product Factory was declared bankrupt and liquidated in July 1994.
The newspaper gave no details of the assets to be auctioned or the number of staff involved.
